title: Support reactions and restraints
description: Three.js support-restraint study with ordered leader annotations, progressive parameters, in-scene display toggles, and corrected focus-mode controls.
learningObjectives: Distinguish restrained degrees of freedom and admissible reaction components for common planar structural supports using a spatial model.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.3.2 adds independent Information and Labels visibility controls and fixes Focus View menu contrast while preserving the analytical model and ordered leader system. Independent engineering, live-browser, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Leader-annotation remediation of the Three.js support reactions asset; analytical model retained from the original repository contribution.
